title: Sources: Moonshot AI is exploring dual Hong Kong and Shanghai listings for greater capital and exposure, amid the weaker performance of AI stocks in Hong Kong (Coco Feng/South China Morning Post)
summary: Coco Feng / South China Morning Post: Sources: Moonshot AI is exploring dual Hong Kong and Shanghai listings for greater capital and exposure, amid the weaker performance of AI stocks in Hong Kong — Moonshot's exploration of dual listings may stem in part from the weaker performance of AI stocks in Hong Kong, the sources said
